rationale: The strain-wave (harmonic) reducer is the single highest-value humanoid chokepoint and currently renders as a bare leaf (depth 3, no children). The flagship decomposes its analogous critical modules 2-3 layers (logic_die -> mask blank -> EUV mask blanks material). A real harmonic drive has 3-4 universally-documented internal parts plus its own feedstock. Decomposing it is the deepest genuine gain in the whole domain and the parts sit at depth 4 (inside budget).

proposedNodes.name: Flexspline (thin-wall flexible gear cup)
proposedNodes.whatItIs: Deformable cylindrical steel cup with external teeth that flexes under the wave generator; the highest-fatigue, hardest-to-make part of a harmonic drive. Made from precision-forged/heat-treated maraging or alloy steel, gear-cut and ground.
proposedNodes.industryBasis: Harmonic Drive AG defines the strain-wave gear as exactly three parts: wave generator, flexspline, circular spline. Flexspline fatigue life is the gear's life-limiter; multiple patents (US11839927, US11198181, US11859705) target flexspline fabrication (metal AM, bulk-metallic-glass) precisely because it is the manufacturing bottleneck.
proposedNodes.likelyCitableSource: harmonicdrive.de/en/technology/harmonic-drive-gears ; USPTO US11839927 'Methods for fabricating strain wave gear flexsplines'

proposedNodes.name: Circular spline (rigid internal ring gear)
proposedNodes.whatItIs: Rigid outer ring with internal teeth (two more teeth than the flexspline) that meshes with the deformed flexspline; precision gear-hobbed/ground hardened steel ring.
proposedNodes.industryBasis: Second of the three canonical harmonic-drive members (Harmonic Drive AG glossary). Tooth-count differential of 2 vs flexspline sets the reduction ratio; requires matched precision gear grinding.
proposedNodes.likelyCitableSource: harmonicdrive.de/en/glossary/harmonic-driver-strain-wave-gear ; en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Strain_wave_gearing

proposedNodes.name: Wave generator (elliptical cam + flex bearing)
proposedNodes.whatItIs: Elliptical steel cam fitted with a thin, elliptically-deformable ball bearing that imposes the travelling deflection wave on the flexspline. Combines the cam plug and a specialty deformable bearing.
proposedNodes.industryBasis: Third canonical harmonic-drive member; the flex (deformable) bearing on it is itself a specialty bearing item that few makers produce. Harmonic Drive AG describes it as 'a centric hub and special thin, elliptically deformable ball bearing'.
proposedNodes.likelyCitableSource: harmonicdrive.de/en/technology/harmonic-drive-gears ; us.sumitomodrive.com strain-wave gearboxes

proposedNodes.name: Output cross-roller bearing (thin-section)
proposedNodes.whatItIs: Single-row crossed-roller bearing that carries the joint's combined moment/radial/axial load in a slim envelope; integrated into the harmonic-drive output or the joint housing. RA-series sizes (e.g. RA5008/RA10008) are the documented hip/shoulder parts.
proposedNodes.industryBasis: Industrial robot joints 'primarily use cross roller bearings (high stiffness, multi-axis loads)'; RA5008/RA10008 are cited as critical for humanoid shoulder/hip joints. Maker set is concentrated (THK, IKO, Schaeffler/INA, plus Harmonic Drive's integrated bearing) -> ADR-0005 concentration-override decomposition-eligible.
proposedNodes.likelyCitableSource: jiabearing.com 2026 robotic joint bearing guide (RA5008/RA10008) ; THK/IKO crossed-roller catalogs

proposedNodes.name: High-cleanliness bearing steel (100Cr6 / GCr15)
proposedNodes.whatItIs: Through-hardening chromium bearing steel (DIN 100Cr6 / GB GCr15 / AISI 52100) with controlled oxygen/inclusion cleanliness; feedstock for cross-roller bearings, flex bearings and roller-screw rollers.
proposedNodes.industryBasis: 100Cr6/GCr15/52100 is the standard precision-bearing steel; bearing fatigue life scales with steel cleanliness (Vacuum-degassed / VIM-VAR grades). Premium-clean bearing steel is supplied by a short list of specialty mills.
proposedNodes.likelyCitableSource: ISO 683-17 bearing steels ; bearing-steel cleanliness literature (e.g. Ovako / proterial specialty steel datasheets)

exposureToAddLater: Harmonic drive (whole reducer): reuse org_humanoid_harmonic_drive_systems (6324.T), org_humanoid_nabtesco (6268.T, RV/precision-reducer), org_humanoid_leaderdrive (688017.SS) -- already in graph; wire to flexspline/circular spline as manufactured_by where evidenced.
Cross-roller bearing: THK (6481.T), IKO/Nippon Thompson (6480.T), Schaeffler (SHA.DE) -- NEW orgs, verify tickers from IR before adding.
Bearing steel: org_proterial already present (Proterial, ex-Hitachi Metals specialty steel) -- candidate feeder; also Ovako (private). Verify product line.
notes: Flexspline/circular spline/wave generator are textbook-canonical (auto-fail risk ~0). Cross-roller bearing + bearing steel are well-attested but verify the RA-size humanoid claim and the bearing-steel maker concentration before C-pass. All 5 attach directly under strain_wave_reducer (depth 3) so they land at depth 4 -- inside the render budget (VERIFIED by simulating the canvasGraph algorithm: the 4 product parts render at d4; the bearing-steel material renders at d4 too IF shipped key-tagged like the existing humanoid_rare_earth_magnet_supply). NOTE: do NOT hang bearing steel under the flexspline -- that pushes it to depth 5, beyond the render budget. Highest single-task genuine gain in the domain.

rationale: Planetary roller screw is the linear-actuator chokepoint (hip/knee/ankle linear joints, dexterous-hand drives). It renders at depth 3 with one child (thread-grinding equipment at depth 4). Its internal parts are documented in patents and vendor literature and the roller-screw maker set is famously concentrated -- a genuine flagship-grade sub-tree. Parts land at depth 4.

proposedNodes.name: Roller-screw threaded shaft (central screw)
proposedNodes.whatItIs: Central screw with precision multi-start thread that the planetary rollers ride; the precision-ground core of the mechanism.
proposedNodes.industryBasis: Patent/vendor decomposition: a planetary roller screw 'comprises a screw with an outer thread, a nut... and a plurality of longitudinal rollers'. EMAG markets dedicated WPG grinding machines for roller-screw shafts; 'screw shaft for humanoid robots... compact design with highest precision requirements'.
proposedNodes.likelyCitableSource: emag.com planetary-roller-screws (WPG 7) ; USPTO US11994191 'Planetary roller screw'

proposedNodes.name: Planetary rollers (single-start grooved rollers)
proposedNodes.whatItIs: Set of threaded rollers between screw and nut with a convex single-start profile; multiplies contact points for high force density. Precision-ground, profile-matched to the nut.
proposedNodes.industryBasis: 'rollers have a single-start thread with an angle matching the nut thread'; 'roller threads must have a consistent convex profile to ensure proper contact stress distribution'. Roller grinding is the hardest step and gates output volume.
proposedNodes.likelyCitableSource: linearmotiontips.com roller-screw performance ; USPTO US11994191

proposedNodes.name: Roller-screw nut (internal-thread + ring gears)
proposedNodes.whatItIs: Coaxial nut with internal multi-start thread and integrated ring gears that time the rollers; precision-machined hardened steel.
proposedNodes.industryBasis: 'a nut mounted coaxially around the screw with an inner thread'; assemblies include 'an internal gear ring and a retainer or cage'. Patent US10041573 covers integrated-ring-gear roller-screw manufacturing.
proposedNodes.likelyCitableSource: zhygear.com planetary-roller-screw-assembly ; USPTO US10041573

exposureToAddLater: Roller-screw makers already in graph: org_humanoid_rollvis (Rollvis SA), org_humanoid_gsa (GSA/Gewinde Ziegler), org_humanoid_drake_manufacturing, org_humanoid_picea_motion -- wire as manufactured_by to shaft/rollers/nut.
Grinding-machine makers: org_humanoid_ptg_holroyd (thread/screw grinders) already present; EMAG (private) candidate NEW for WPG roller-screw grinders.
Bearing-steel feeder reuses humanoid_bearing_steel_feedstock from H1 (rollers are 52100-class).
notes: Three canonical roller-screw parts; reuses bearing-steel material (H1) and existing thread-grinding-equipment leaf, deepening it via implemented_by. Land at depth 4. Reuses 4 existing roller-screw orgs -- strong exposure with no new-org risk.

rationale: The hand subsystem dead-ends entirely at depth 2 (5 leaves, 0 children). It is one of the two named flagship-tier focus areas (owner whole-robot scope) and is the most active 2025-2026 design frontier (Tesla Optimus Gen-3 22-DoF redesign). The actuation cell of a tendon hand (motor + micro screw + tactile element) is well-documented and decomposes cleanly to depth 3.

proposedNodes.name: Coreless / hollow-cup micro motor
proposedNodes.whatItIs: Small coreless (ironless-rotor) brushed or slotless BLDC motor that drives one hand DoF; chosen for low inertia and high acceleration in the forearm actuator pack.
proposedNodes.industryBasis: Tesla Optimus Gen-3 hand uses a 'hollow cup + lead screw + rope drive' scheme with ~13-17 coreless/slotless motors per hand, actuators relocated to the forearm. maxon (in graph) and Shenzhen PICEA Motion are named coreless-motor suppliers.
proposedNodes.likelyCitableSource: robottoday.com Optimus hand redesign (hollow cup + lead screw + rope) ; foxtechrobotics.com Tesla dexterous-hand insight

proposedNodes.name: Hand micro lead-screw / ball-screw drive
proposedNodes.whatItIs: Miniature lead or ball screw that converts the hollow-cup motor's rotation into the linear pull on a finger tendon; the rotary-to-linear stage of each finger drive.
proposedNodes.industryBasis: Optimus Gen-3 hand 'motor rotation is converted into linear motion through the screw, which then pulls the tendon connected to the finger bones'; Gen-3 likely adopts 'gearbox, lead screw, and tendon drive'.
proposedNodes.likelyCitableSource: robottoday.com Optimus hand redesign ; optimusk.blog Tesla Optimus hardware specs

proposedNodes.name: Fingertip tactile sensing element (MEMS/magnetic/visuotactile)
proposedNodes.whatItIs: The transducer inside the fingertip tactile array -- a MEMS barometric/capacitive die, a magnetic (Hall) tactile cell, or a camera-based visuotactile module -- that converts contact force/slip into signals.
proposedNodes.industryBasis: Tactile fingertip sensors provide force-feedback hardware in each fingertip; tactile sensing is the named critical enabler for dexterous manipulation. Suppliers in graph: org_humanoid_paxini, org_humanoid_xela_robotics (tactile), org_humanoid_te_connectivity (force).
proposedNodes.likelyCitableSource: foxtechrobotics.com humanoid dexterous-hands sensing ; arxiv 2512.24657 Bowden-cable hand

exposureToAddLater: Hollow-cup motor: org_maxon (already present), org_humanoid_picea_motion (PICEA, already present) -- wire manufactured_by.
Tactile element: org_humanoid_paxini, org_humanoid_xela_robotics, org_humanoid_te_connectivity (all present).
Micro lead-screw: reuse roller-screw makers where they make miniature screws (Rollvis/GSA) or flag as new precision-screw frontier.
notes: Grounded in the well-covered 2025-2026 Optimus Gen-3 hand redesign. Attaches under existing micro_hand_actuator (depth 3) and fingertip_tactile_array (depth 3), so the new parts are depth 4. Reuses 5 existing orgs + magnet material. Keep claims architecture-level (hollow-cup + screw + tendon + tactile) -- do NOT assert exact Tesla part counts as facts beyond the cited range.

rationale: Battery subsystem dead-ends at depth 2 (5 module leaves). It is in the owner whole-robot scope and is the #1 humanoid duty-cycle constraint. Humanoid has only 2 materials vs flagship's 33 -- the Li-ion cell is the single richest real materials node in the domain (cathode/anode/separator/electrolyte are universal, citable, and each is a genuine supply-concentrated layer). Materials don't lift the rendered count but are core flagship depth + carry heavy exposure.

proposedNodes.name: Cathode active material (high-nickel NMC)
proposedNodes.whatItIs: Nickel-rich layered oxide (NMC, e.g. 8:1:1 Ni:Mn:Co) cathode powder; sets the cell's energy density and the bulk of its cost, and pulls in nickel/cobalt/lithium feedstock.
proposedNodes.industryBasis: A Li-ion cell = cathode + anode + separator + electrolyte; high-energy humanoid cells run NMC at ~250-300 Wh/kg. NMC ~80Ni/10Mn/10Co. Cathode is the dominant cost/energy driver.
proposedNodes.likelyCitableSource: ufinebattery.com humanoid battery pack design ; arxiv 2008.10896 cathode materials review

proposedNodes.name: Anode active material (graphite / Si-blend)
proposedNodes.whatItIs: Graphite (natural or synthetic) anode, increasingly with silicon additive for capacity; second core electrode material.
proposedNodes.industryBasis: Anode is one of the four canonical cell components; Si-blended graphite is the route to the higher gravimetric energy humanoid duty cycles demand.
proposedNodes.likelyCitableSource: ufinebattery.com humanoid battery pack design ; manlybattery.com humanoid battery program

proposedNodes.name: Battery separator (microporous polyolefin)
proposedNodes.whatItIs: Microporous PE/PP film (often ceramic-coated) that prevents anode-cathode contact while passing ions; a safety-critical, supply-concentrated specialty film.
proposedNodes.industryBasis: 'The separator prevents the cathode from directly contacting the anode... while allowing current-carrying ions to pass.' Separator film is a recognized chokepoint (few qualified high-power makers).
proposedNodes.likelyCitableSource: ufinebattery.com humanoid battery pack design ; large-battery.com humanoid battery design challenges

proposedNodes.name: BMS analog front-end / fuel-gauge IC
proposedNodes.whatItIs: Multi-cell monitoring AFE IC that measures per-cell voltage/temperature/current and balances cells; the silicon heart of the battery-management module.
proposedNodes.industryBasis: 'The BMS monitors cell voltages, temperature, and current, balancing load.' AFE/fuel-gauge ICs are supplied by a short list (TI, Analog Devices, NXP) -- org_humanoid_texas_instruments and org_nxp already in graph.
proposedNodes.likelyCitableSource: ufinebattery.com humanoid battery pack design ; TI/ADI BMS AFE product pages

exposureToAddLater: Cells: org_catl, org_eve_energy, org_lg_energy_solution, org_samsung_sdi, org_panasonic, org_molicel (all present) -- wire manufactured_by to cell_selection.
Cathode/anode/separator: NEW upstream merchant tier (e.g. cathode: Sumitomo Metal Mining 5713.T, L&F; separator: Asahi Kasei 3407.T, SEMCORP 300568.SZ) -- verify tickers, ADR-0005 corners pass.
BMS AFE: org_humanoid_texas_instruments, org_nxp, org_humanoid_stmicroelectronics (present); ADI (ADI) NEW.
notes: 1 equipment (BMS AFE, +1 certain) + 3 materials (cathode/anode/separator). Delta counts ONLY the BMS AFE conservatively. The 3 materials DO render (+3 more) IF shipped key-tagged (bottleneck/hard_to_develop) like the 2 existing humanoid materials -- VERIFIED in the canvasGraph simulation at depth 3; if shipped untagged they are not canvas nodes and add 0. Either way they are genuine flagship depth + heavy exposure carriers and close most of the materials gap (2 -> 5+). Cathode/anode/separator are textbook-canonical -- near-zero overfit.

rationale: The frameless BLDC torque motor renders at depth 3 with one child (rare-earth magnet material at depth 3). The motor is the second actuation chokepoint after the reducer; its windings (copper magnet wire) and laminations (electrical/silicon steel) are universal, citable materials that also fill the materials gap. Parts land at depth 4.

proposedNodes.name: Electrical (silicon) steel laminations
proposedNodes.whatItIs: Thin grain-oriented / non-oriented Si-Fe laminations stacked to form the motor stator/rotor core; low-loss electrical steel is a supply-concentrated specialty.
proposedNodes.industryBasis: Frameless torque motors use laminated electrical-steel cores; thin high-grade non-oriented electrical steel for high-speed robot motors is made by a short list of mills (Nippon Steel, POSCO, JFE, Baowu). Raw-material lists for robot motors include 'Iron, Steel, ... Copper'.
proposedNodes.likelyCitableSource: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neodymium_magnet raw-materials ; electrical-steel grade datasheets (Nippon Steel / POSCO non-oriented)

proposedNodes.name: Copper magnet (enamelled) wire
proposedNodes.whatItIs: Insulated copper winding wire for the motor stator coils; gauge/insulation class set slot fill and thermal rating.
proposedNodes.industryBasis: Copper magnet wire is the universal motor winding material; raw-material inputs to robot/EV motors explicitly include copper. Slot-fill and insulation class gate torque density and duty cycle.
proposedNodes.likelyCitableSource: emworks.com motor magnet-material blog (winding context) ; magnet-wire (IEC 60317) standards

proposedNodes.name: Sintered NdFeB magnet feedstock (Nd2Fe14B + Dy/Tb)
proposedNodes.whatItIs: Sintered neodymium-iron-boron magnet blanks (with Dy/Tb for high-temp coercivity) -- the upstream feedstock that the 'rare-earth magnet supply' node converts into finished arc magnets.
proposedNodes.industryBasis: NdFeB (Nd2Fe14B) is the highest-energy-product permanent magnet and the standard robot-motor magnet; Dy/Tb heavy-rare-earth addition raises coercivity for hot joint motors. Sintered-magnet supply is a recognized chokepoint (China-concentrated).
proposedNodes.likelyCitableSource: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neodymium_magnet ; mpmaterials.com NdFeB magnets ; arnoldmagnetics.com NdFeB

exposureToAddLater: NdFeB magnet: org_jl_mag_rare_earth (300748.SZ) already present; MP Materials (MP) NEW for ex-China; Proterial (present) makes magnets too.
Electrical steel: NEW upstream (Nippon Steel 5401.T, POSCO 005490.KS, Baowu/Baosteel 600019.SS) -- verify tickers, upstream pass.
Copper magnet wire: largely commodity -- per ADR-0005 keep as material leaf unless a <=3-holder specialty (e.g. high-temp robot-grade) emerges; do NOT over-decompose.
notes: All three are materials. Counted as +0 conservatively, BUT if shipped key-tagged they each render: stator lamination steel + copper magnet wire render at depth 4 (under frameless_bldc_motor at d3); NdFeB feedstock at d4 (under rare_earth_magnet_supply at d3) -- VERIFIED in simulation. So real upside is up to +3. They are core flagship-depth feedstock and major exposure carriers (rare-earth + electrical-steel chains). NdFeB feedstock deepens the existing rare-earth node by one layer (upstream pass). Respect ADR-0005: copper wire stays a leaf unless a real specialty corner is found.

rationale: Six-axis force/torque sensor renders as a depth-2 leaf. It is the named force-sensing chokepoint (wrist/ankle), heavily documented in the literature, and decomposes cleanly into elastic element + strain-gauge/transducer + signal conditioning. Parts land at depth 3.

proposedNodes.name: Sensor elastic element (compliant spoke/Maltese-cross body)
proposedNodes.whatItIs: Precision-machined metal elastomer (spoke/Maltese-cross/compliant beam) whose strain encodes the 6-axis load; the mechanical core of the sensor.
proposedNodes.industryBasis: 'Six-axis force/torque sensors use elastomers manufactured through precision machining with metallic strain gauges precisely arranged on them to form multiple Wheatstone bridges.' Elastic-element design (low cross-axis coupling) is the core IP.
proposedNodes.likelyCitableSource: karlancer.com optimized six-axis F/T sensor (PDF) ; sciencedirect S0263224125007079 compliant 6-axis sensor

proposedNodes.name: Strain transducer (foil gauge / silicon piezoresistor)
proposedNodes.whatItIs: Foil strain gauges or silicon piezoresistive die bonded to the elastic element and wired into Wheatstone bridges; the transduction element.
proposedNodes.industryBasis: 'Strain gauges are attached to the four surfaces of the beams... to form Wheatstone bridges'; MEMS variants use ion-implanted piezoresistors. Bridge trimming and gauge bonding are the precision steps.
proposedNodes.likelyCitableSource: nature.com s41378-024-00831-0 silicon capacitive 6-axis sensor ; pmc.ncbi PMC9100792 6-axis F/T manufacture

exposureToAddLater: F/T sensor makers in graph: org_humanoid_bota_systems, org_humanoid_novanta_ati (ATI), org_humanoid_sri_sunrise (Sunrise/SRI), org_humanoid_te_connectivity -- wire to sensor / elastic element.
Strain-gauge specialists: NEW candidates (e.g. HBK/Hottinger private, Kyowa) -- verify before add; many are private so qualitative tag likely.
notes: Two-part decomposition (elastic body + transducer) is the standard textbook split; reuses 4 existing F/T orgs. Elastic element depth 3, transducer depth 4 -- both inside budget.

rationale: Joint encoder renders as a depth-2 leaf. Absolute joint encoders (commutation + position) are a real per-joint cost and a documented dual-encoder design point. Decomposes into the sensing element (magnetic ASIC or optical disk) + interface -- standard, citable. Parts land at depth 3.

proposedNodes.name: Magnetic encoder ASIC (Hall array) + diametric magnet
proposedNodes.whatItIs: A diametrically-polarized magnet rotating over an ASIC Hall-sensor array that resolves absolute angle; the dominant compact robot-joint encoder type.
proposedNodes.industryBasis: 'A small, diametrically polarized magnet rotates above an ASIC containing an array of Hall effect sensors... generates a voltage as the magnet rotates.' Magnetic encoder ASICs are supplied by a short list (e.g. AMS-OSRAM, Renishaw, MPS).
proposedNodes.likelyCitableSource: machinedesign.com rotary-encoder basics ; ttelectronics.com optical-vs-magnetic encoders

proposedNodes.name: Optical code disk + photodetector (high-res absolute)
proposedNodes.whatItIs: Etched glass/metal code disk read by an LED/photodetector array for high-resolution absolute position where magnetic resolution is insufficient (output-side encoder).
proposedNodes.industryBasis: 'Optical encoders include a disc (code plate), a sensor, and a processor, with the disc including a predetermined pattern'; absolute optical encoders use 'multiple concentric discs... each tic provides a unique binary code.' Output-side optical encoders co-exist with motor-side magnetic ones (hybrid designs documented).
proposedNodes.likelyCitableSource: arxiv 2206.03223 sensors for mobile robots ; USPTO US11002562 hybrid magnetic+optical encoder

exposureToAddLater: Encoder makers in graph: org_humanoid_netzer (Netzer, electric encoders), org_humanoid_tdk (Hall/magnetic sensing) -- wire manufactured_by.
NEW candidates: Renishaw (RSW.L), AMS-OSRAM (AMS.SW), MPS/Monolithic Power (MPWR) for magnetic ASIC -- verify tickers, breadth pass.
notes: Magnetic ASIC is the certain mainstream part (low risk). Optical code-disk is real but NOT every humanoid joint carries one -- frame it as the high-res / output-side option (dual-encoder designs), not a universal requirement, to avoid an overfit miss. Both at depth 3.

rationale: Structure subsystem has a generic 'high-stiffness low-mass materials' leaf but does not name the actual structural feedstocks. Mass is a first-order humanoid constraint and the material set (Al alloy, Mg alloy, PEEK/CF) is specifically documented for Optimus. Materials don't lift the rendered count but are flagship-depth + carry real exposure (e.g. PEEK, Mg).

proposedNodes.name: Magnesium alloy (die-cast structural)
proposedNodes.whatItIs: Lightest structural metal (~1.8 g/cm3) used for skeletal/joint housings and shells to cut mass and aid thermal spreading.
proposedNodes.industryBasis: 'Magnesium alloys are a core material in Tesla's Optimus Gen 2, helping reduce component weight... and enhance thermal management.' Density ~1.8 g/cm3.
proposedNodes.likelyCitableSource: peekchina.com PEEK lightweight materials (Optimus G3) ; goodfellow.com advanced materials for humanoid robots

proposedNodes.name: PEEK / carbon-fiber-reinforced polymer
proposedNodes.whatItIs: High-performance thermoplastic (PEEK, often carbon-fiber-reinforced) for joint mechanisms, brackets and wear parts -- metal-like specific strength at low mass.
proposedNodes.industryBasis: 'PEEK... specific strength exceeding many conventional metals, often used in skeletal structures and joint mechanisms... reinforced with carbon fiber.' Supplier org_humanoid_victrex (Victrex, PEEK) and org_humanoid_evonik already in graph.
proposedNodes.likelyCitableSource: peekchina.com 8 essential plastics for humanoid robots ; partinchem.com lighter-more-durable robots

proposedNodes.name: Aerospace/structural aluminum alloy
proposedNodes.whatItIs: Machined/cast aluminum alloy (density ~2.7 g/cm3, ~1/3 of steel) for primary frame members and brackets.
proposedNodes.industryBasis: 'Aluminum alloys have a density of 2.63-2.85 g/cm3 -- just one-third that of steel -- and offer excellent casting, processing... corrosion resistance.' Standard humanoid frame material.
proposedNodes.likelyCitableSource: goodfellow.com advanced materials for humanoid robots ; partinchem.com robot materials

Magnesium / aluminum: largely commodity at ingot level -- per ADR-0005 keep as material leaves unless a robot-specific cast-Mg corner emerges; do NOT add commodity-metal orgs.

proposedNodes.whatItIs: The low-voltage power MOSFET or GaN FET that switches joint-motor phase current; sets inverter efficiency, size and thermal load.
proposedNodes.industryBasis: Joint inverters for ~48V humanoid motors use low-voltage Si MOSFETs or GaN FETs; GaN is an active humanoid power-density frontier. Suppliers org_infineon, org_humanoid_epc (EPC, GaN), org_humanoid_texas_instruments, org_humanoid_stmicroelectronics all in graph.
